description: Search the Cyprus Registrar of Companies public register by company name or registration number and return the entity, its registration number, type, name status and whether it is active. Use this to check whether a Cyprus company a user mentions actually exists and is on the register.

name.description: Company name, or part of it.

registration_number.description: Registration number, with or without the HE prefix.

sound_like.description: Match names that sound similar rather than only exact text. Defaults to false.

name: cyprus_company_lookup
title: Look up an existing Cyprus company
